description: The file is a comprehensive documentation and interface guide for a HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) component managing composite video input ports. It details interface definitions, operation modes, event handling, discovery patterns, capabilities, and implementation considerations for the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface in an Android-based platform.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Encapsulates capabilities of a specific composite input port, including supported properties, signals, and metrics support.

classes.name: PortStatus
classes.description: Represents the current status of a port, including connection state, signal status, and video mode.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum indicating the current signal state (NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED).

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Contains details about the current video resolution and format of the input signal.

classes.name: PropertyValue
classes.description: Union type representing various types of property values (e.g., long, int, string, float).

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair used for batch property queries, containing the property key and its corresponding value.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Provides information about overall platform-wide support and feature flags related to composite input ports.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available composite input port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the interface for a specific port by its ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns supported capabilities and properties for a given port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property key.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch retrieval of multiple property values.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Obtains current telemetry metrics for the port, if supported.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation; only allowed if signal is stable.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to receive connection, signal, and video mode change events.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers callback for telemetry metrics updates, if supported.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Fetches descriptive metadata about the port (name, description).

calls: Hardware/AFE hardware signals (cable detect, signal lock/unlock)
Event callbacks for signal status changes
Event callbacks for video mode changes
Property queries for signal strength, metrics, and other port properties
setActive() invoked to start video presentation when signal is stable
